## English

This directory contains the BSD45 port glue (boot, monitor, syscall bridge) — tests/nfs/unix-tests/tools.

`config.mk` records 8 source file(s) here: `dirdmp.c`, `dirprt.c`, `pmapbrd.c`, `pmaptst.c`, `tcp.c`, `tcpd.c`, `udp.c`, `udpd.c`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
